name: public-apis
description: A collective list of free APIs
one_liner: A giant, community-maintained list of free APIs you can call from your own code — weather, currency, trivia, and hundreds more, all in one directory.
buyer: Honestly, nobody pays for this directly — it's a reference list for developers, not a product. Its value is as a starting point, not as something to sell.
business_use_cases: A developer browses it to quickly find a free data source instead of building one from scratch, saving research time on a side project.
A coding bootcamp uses it as a source of beginner project ideas built around real, free APIs.

money_ideas.idea: None directly — any money made is one step removed, e.g. a paid curated/filtered version with uptime checks and better search.

steal_this: Build a tiny paid search/filter layer on top (uptime-checked, categorized, with code snippets) rather than trying to monetize the list itself.
